class.name: rp1_hardware_interface/Rp1Hardware
class.description: Speaks DroneCAN directly over SocketCAN for rp1's VESCs, both wheel kinds on one bus and one node ID. A joint declaring "esc_index" is a drive wheel: velocity command via uavcan.equipment.esc.RPMCommand, feedback from esc.Status. A joint declaring "actuator_id" is a steering actuator: position command via uavcan.equipment.actuator.ArrayCommand, feedback from actuator.Status. Both id values are the uavcan_esc_index configured on that VESC -- see docs/can_id_map.md. Per-ESC voltage/current/temperature is exported through <gpio> state interfaces keyed by the same esc_index.
